COM_shape: selected envs x selected bodies x 7 or Warp transformf
COM_frame: each body link frame; COM pose is pos_xyz + quaternion_xyzw
COM_setter_behavior: updates actual buffer then sends full body COM poses for only selected environment indices to PhysX; preserve other bodies and quaternion
COM_candidate_body: chassis explicitly named by frozen task; actual body order/index/mass and COM must still be read from live SDK, not assumed
COM_total_system_shift: mass-weighted chassis contribution, not an asserted equal shift of total robot COM
PD_setter_warning: PhysX write_joint_stiffness/damping methods update simulation drives and buffers, not actuator model coefficients. DCMotor explicit PD must change only its actual model coefficients, preserving zero implicit motor drives; this requires real SDK readback before integration.
